inputs.text: Open your eyes, it is all a staged theater. They feed us this narrative about China and the United States working together to "consolidate unity" and build the Paris Agreement, but that is just a smokescreen for the real agenda of globalist control. Look at how they play their game, with the US supposedly withdrawing "for the second time under the Donald Trump administration"—it is entirely fabricated opposition designed to keep the masses confused and compliant with unseen mandates. Do not buy into the official story; this entire public dance is nothing more than coordinated manipulation to advance their hidden agenda while pretending to fight.
